s: Kivvun ebarayv bishat hattepilla ubo d' seipim: hammitpallel tzarik sheykavven raglayv zo etzel zo bekivvun keillu enan ella regel echad, lehiddamot lammalakim shenneemar bahem "veraglehem regel yeshara", kelomar raglehem nirot keregel echad. Vetob lekavven raglayv gam kesheomer qedushsha im sheliach tzibbur, shehare omer "neqaddesh … keshem shemmaqdishim … bishme marom", ubammarom maqdishim ken beregel yeshara:
Yesh mi sheomer shekkesheomed lehitpallel yelek lepanayv g' pesiot, derek qerub vehaggasha ledabar shetztzarik laasot. Vetob lachosh lidbarayv:

Katub echad omer: "vehayu enay velibbi sham kol hayyamim", vekatub echad omer: "nissa lebabenu el kappayim el el bashshamayim", ukede sheyyitqayyemu b' miqraot ellu ameru shehammitpallel tzarik sheyyakop rosho meat sheyyihyu enayv lematta laaretz, shehare anu mitpalelim neged bet hammiqdash shenneemar bo "vehayu enay velibbi sham ku'", laken yitten enayv lematta kenegdo veyachashob keillu omed bo umitpallel, veal yede zeh tepillato retzuya, ubelibbo yekavven lemala "el el shebbashshamayim" (veotan hammagbihim rashehem veenehem lemala kemabbitim al haggag — hammalakim maligim alehem). Veqodem hattepilla yissa enayv lashshamayim, leorer hakkavvana. Veken betok hattepilla im nitbattela kavvanato, kemo shennitbaer besiman tz':

Tzarik laamod battepilla keebed lipne rabbo beema beyira bepachad. Veal yanniach yadayv al chalatzayv, mippene shehu derek yuhara. Vetob sheyyannichen al libbo keputin haymanit al hassemalit, bemaqom shennohagin laamod ken lipne hammelek keshemmedabberim immo veshoalin meitto tzorkehem. Vehakkol keminhag hammaqom. Venohagim qetzat mittaam hayyadua lahem lakop haagudal betok pissat hayyad. Veyesh nohagin mittaam hayyadua lahem lehanniach zerootehem al libbam yemanit al semalit sheyyihyeh pereq emtzai mishte zeroot neged pene hammitpallel:
